race.comment: Interesting race. Want to be away from the couple at the top of the weights who have been penalised heavily for winning good races at two. BUGGSY (12) gets in on the minimum here first up, He won well on debut over this route as favourite, solid at Caulfield when well backed again. Looks a speedy sort who draws ideally for Williams and will take catching. SHOOTING BRAKE (9) resumes having placed in both starts to date, behind Natural Fling before a break which is top form. Hard to hold out. JACARANDA (5) was solid fresh in Adelaide against the 3yo's, she's in the mix from the resuming DIVINE DOT (3) who has good speed and looks suited here.
